image.title: Image Generation
image.description: Offline image generation for supported CPU, GPU and Snapdragon hardware. Start with the essential selection or explore additional styles in the full catalog.

image_tools.title: Image Tools
image_tools.description: Offline tools for Q-Dream Studio, downloaded only if you use them: reading the text in photos and documents, cutting out their subjects, removing objects, making pictures four times larger, drawing new pictures along a sketch or a picture's outlines.

image_gen.title: Image Generation
image_gen.description: On-device Stable Diffusion packs for the Q-Dream (CPU and Snapdragon NPU) and sd.cpp runtimes.

ocr.title: Text Reading (OCR)
ocr.description: PaddleOCR PP-OCRv6 packs that read printed text in pictures on the device, for Q-Dream Studio.

segmentation.title: Cut-outs
segmentation.description: Packs that cut people and objects out of pictures, or select the object you touch, on the device, for Q-Dream Studio.

erase.title: Object removal
erase.description: Packs that remove what you select from a photo and rebuild the scene in its place, with no words, on the device, for Q-Dream Studio.

upscale.title: Upscaling
upscale.description: Packs that make a picture four times larger and draw its fine detail again, on the device, for Q-Dream Studio.

guide.title: Drawing guides
guide.description: Packs that make a new picture follow lines: a shape you draw, or the outlines of a picture you have, on the device, for Q-Dream Studio.

ocr_page.title: Page reading
ocr_page.description: Reads the text of scanned pages and photos of documents, line by line, so the archive can search and cite them.

packs.name: PP-OCRv6 Small · Text reading
packs.description: Reads printed text in photos, screenshots and documents, offline: Italian, English and 46 other Latin-script languages, Chinese and Japanese. PaddleOCR PP-OCRv6 (June 2026), the more accurate tier at mobile speed. Download 31 MB.

packs.name: PP-OCRv6 Tiny · Text reading
packs.description: The same languages in a 6 MB download, for phones with little memory or space: faster, a little less accurate. PaddleOCR PP-OCRv6 (June 2026).

packs.name: BiRefNet Lite 512 — Cut-outs
packs.description: Cuts people and objects out of photos on the device, hair and fine edges included, for transparent PNGs. BiRefNet lite (bilateral reference segmentation), its mask brought to the photo's full size along the photo's own edges. About 5 to 12 seconds a photo.
packs.sourceOrg: ZhengPeng7 (BiRefNet), ONNX export by Studio Ludens; kept by Q-P1NG

packs.name: EdgeTAM — Select by touch
packs.description: Selects any object you touch or draw a box around, on the device: a mask to cut out, cover or edit. EdgeTAM (Meta, 2025), Segment Anything 2 made for phones: the photo is looked at once, in 1 to 3 seconds, then each touch takes under a second.
packs.sourceOrg: Meta (EdgeTAM), ONNX export by onnx-community; kept by Q-P1NG

packs.name: Big-LaMa 512 · Object removal
packs.description: Removes what you select from a photo and rebuilds the scene in its place, with no words, on the device, large areas included: Big-LaMa (Samsung AI Center, WACV 2022), Fourier convolutions that see the whole picture at once. About 9 seconds a removal. Code and weights Apache-2.0; trained on Places2, a scene dataset licensed for non-commercial research.
packs.sourceOrg: Samsung AI Center (LaMa); ONNX conversion by Artiva, kept by Imaging for Good

packs.name: Real-ESRGAN 4x · Upscale
packs.description: Makes a picture four times larger and draws its fine detail again, on the device: Real-ESRGAN general x4v3 (Xintao Wang et al., Tencent ARC), a compact network trained to clean up noise and compression as it enlarges. Pictures up to 1024 pixels a side, 4096 once enlarged. Code and weights BSD-3-Clause. Download 2.4 MB.
packs.sourceOrg: Xintao Wang et al. (Real-ESRGAN, Tencent ARC); float16 export by Q-Dream

packs.name: T2I-Adapter Sketch · Draw the shape
packs.description: Makes a new picture follow a shape you draw with your finger in Q-Dream Studio: T2I-Adapter for Stable Diffusion 1.5 (TencentARC), run on the device once per picture, so a picture takes almost no longer. Works with the Q-Dream CPU models (DreamShaper 8, CyberRealistic, Realistic Vision). Apache-2.0. Download 77.6 MB.
packs.sourceOrg: TencentARC (T2I-Adapter); int8 MNN conversion by Q-Dream

packs.name: T2I-Adapter Canny · Recreate from outlines
packs.description: Makes a new picture follow the outlines of one you have (same composition, another subject or style) in Q-Dream Studio: T2I-Adapter for Stable Diffusion 1.5 (TencentARC), run on the device once per picture, so a picture takes almost no longer. Works with the Q-Dream CPU models (DreamShaper 8, CyberRealistic, Realistic Vision). Apache-2.0. Download 77.6 MB.
packs.sourceOrg: TencentARC (T2I-Adapter); int8 MNN conversion by Q-Dream
